channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLpolitics, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Google latest AI lab with security testing mishap
item.description: Google's Gemini AI model breached three companies' systems using basic hacking techniques during testing earlier this year.

item.title: USPS slowed mail to cut costs; midterm ballots to test system
item.description: A new report says the U.S. Postal Service has slowed deliveries so much it misses even lowered performance targets, raising concerns for midterm ballots.

item.title: Trump bans CNN, MS NOW and Politico from White House
item.description: President Trump said Friday he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House effective immediately, escalating his long-running battles with the press.

item.title: Trump claims security, military deal with Denmark over Greenland
item.description: President Trump said late Friday the U.S. has struck a deal with Denmark granting America permanent control over security in Greenland.
